messages.subject: Re: ggplot2 histogram
parts:
Hi:

One approach is to convert argmax.w to a factor, create a table of its
values and plot the table. By creating a factor, you can define its
levels and labels to include those that will have zero frequencies.
Running table() on a factor will produce frequencies for all of its
levels. The table can be coerced into a data frame which you pass to
ggplot().

u <- factor(argmax.w, levels = seq_along(w.vals), labels = w.vals)
v <- as.data.frame(table(u))
ggplot(v, aes(x = u, y = Freq)) +
geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
labs(x = "w*", y = "count")

Dennis
